hook.title: When the AI keeps getting it wrong, *do this*
hook.cover: When AI keeps getting it wrong

scenes.title: Start a *new* chat
scenes.body: Long chats pile up wrong turns, and it keeps building on them.

scenes.title: Bring a *summary*
scenes.body: Ask it to sum up the goal, what works and what failed. Paste that into the new chat.

scenes.title: *Clean* context, better answers
scenes.body: It sees the problem fresh, not its own last five failed attempts.

end.title: Save this for the next time it *loops*
end.sub: follow for daily AI + code tips

caption:
If the AI keeps suggesting the same broken fix, more messages usually won't help. Every wrong attempt is still sitting in the conversation.

Ask it to summarize the goal, what works and what's failed. Start a new chat and paste the summary. Fresh context, and it stops repeating itself.

Save this for the next time it loops.
